SSH to westd-41312 and:

1. First check if huggingface-cli is available:
   ```
   which huggingface-cli || pip install -U huggingface_hub
   ```

2. Check available disk space:
   ```
   df -h /root/autodl-tmp/
   ```

3. Download the model:
   ```
   huggingface-cli download Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B --local-dir /root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/models/Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B
   ```
   
   If that path structure doesn't exist, try:
   ```
   mkdir -p /root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/models/Qwen/
   ```
   
   Also check if models are stored elsewhere:
   ```
   find /root -maxdepth 4 -name "Qwen3-0.6B" -type d 2>/dev/null
   ```
   Use the same parent directory structure for 1.7B.

4. If huggingface download is slow or blocked, try:
   ```
   # Alternative: use git clone with lfs
   cd /root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/models/Qwen/
   GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 git clone https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B
   cd Qwen3-1.7B
   git lfs pull
